source: Owner direct chat after refining the original-character and weapon-animation plan
decision: Create a separate Multica task family for the agreed original full-body first-person protagonist and one-rifle integration plan.

owner_scope.model: Create a unique original protagonist, including coherent body and first-person arms; do not substitute a ready-made character.
owner_scope.presentation: Visible body on look-down, correct movement, complete shadow, and stepping legs during camera turns.
owner_scope.animation_reuse: Existing D:/devgames/Weapon pack and suitable free Fab/Epic animation assets are allowed, subject to quality review.
owner_scope.weapon: One rifle; ordinary/nonempty and empty reloads, each with an aimed variant; selected arm locomotion for running, jumping and crouching.
owner_scope.environment: Integrate gameplay into the current lobby while preserving its scene, assets, owner edits and historical evidence. Existing environment tasks remain closed.

gates: Independent concept review followed by explicit owner selection of an exact named art package before original model production.
Animation audit rig contract and deformation checks before final detail and materials.
Fresh independent final review and bounded corrections before owner playtest; final appearance acceptance remains the owner's decision.
